name: jwt-signature-audience-validator
explain: A production JWT validator enforces cryptographic HMAC signatures, not-before and expiration time bounds, issuer and audience claims to defeat confused-deputy attacks, and token revocation blocklists.
steps: Verify cryptographic signatures and enforce explicit algorithm allowlists. || Assert expiration and not-before claims within clock skew thresholds. || Enforce exact issuer and audience matches to defeat confused-deputy attacks. || Check token identifiers against distributed revocation blocklists.
expect: Production JWT signature, audience, and revocation validation verified successfully.

name: browser-cookies-cors-csrf
explain: Browser security controls combine HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite cookie attributes with CORS preflight handlers and synchronizer anti-CSRF tokens for state-mutating requests.
steps: Construct hardened Set-Cookie headers with HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite attributes. || Handle CORS preflight OPTIONS requests with explicit Origin allowlists. || Require and validate synchronizer anti-CSRF tokens on state-mutating HTTP methods.
expect: Browser cookie controls, CORS preflight, and CSRF token defenses verified successfully.

name: contextvar-identity-tenant-isolation
explain: ContextVar isolates authenticated caller identity across concurrent async tasks, distinguishing global RBAC roles from object-level resource ownership while preventing model-injected identity spoofing.
steps: Propagate authenticated identity via ContextVar across asynchronous task execution boundaries. || Enforce object-level resource ownership in database queries independently from global RBAC roles. || Bind tools strictly to ContextVar principal, completely ignoring model-supplied user parameters.
expect: ContextVar identity isolation, RBAC vs ownership, and model spoofing defenses verified successfully.

name: password-hashing-argon2-timing
explain: Production password security uses high-iteration salted key derivation, constant-time verification to prevent timing attacks, and automatic rehash detection for work factor upgrades.
steps: Derive cryptographic password hashes using unique random salts and recommended iteration counts. || Perform constant-time hash comparisons using hmac.compare_digest to eliminate timing side channels. || Detect outdated iteration counts upon successful verification and upgrade hashes automatically.
expect: Password hashing, timing attack defense, and rehash migration verified successfully.

name: capability-confirmation-tokens
explain: High-impact actions require HMAC-signed capability confirmation tokens that cryptographically bind the action, target, operator, and parameters, enforcing single-use replay protection.
steps: Issue signed capability tokens embedding action, target, operator, and SHA-256 parameter hashes. || Verify token cryptographic signatures and short-lived expiration deadlines. || Detect parameter tampering and prevent replay attacks by recording consumed capability nonces.
expect: Capability confirmation tokens and parameter tamper-proofing verified successfully.

name: layered-limits-token-budgets
explain: Layered protection combines pre-parsing HTTP request size bounds, token-bucket sliding-window rate limiters, and per-turn agent tool execution budgets.
steps: Reject oversized HTTP payloads prior to memory allocation with 413 Payload Too Large. || Smooth traffic bursts and shed excess load using a token-bucket rate limiter returning 429. || Enforce agent tool execution budgets to prevent infinite model recursion and runaway inference token costs.
expect: Layered limits: Request sizes, rate limits, and agent tool budgets verified successfully.

name: ssrf-dns-resolution-defense
explain: Server-Side Request Forgery defense validates outbound URL schemes, performs pre-flight DNS resolution, blocks loopback, private subnets, and cloud metadata (169.254.169.254), and pins safe IPs to prevent DNS rebinding.
steps: Enforce an HTTPS-only scheme allowlist and reject non-HTTP schemes. || Perform pre-flight DNS resolution on target hostnames before socket initialization. || Block loopback, RFC 1918 private subnets, and link-local cloud metadata IP ranges. || Pin the validated IP address to the outbound socket connection to eliminate DNS rebinding.
expect: SSRF pre-flight DNS validation and cloud metadata defenses verified successfully.

name: safe-error-responses-threat-model
explain: Safe error handling returns uniform 404 responses to eliminate resource enumeration, redacts internal stack traces and database credentials, and evaluates vulnerabilities using the STRIDE threat model.
steps: Return uniform 404 Not Found outcomes for missing and unauthorized resources to prevent enumeration. || Redact database connection strings, SQL queries, and stack traces from client responses while logging correlation IDs. || Produce structured STRIDE threat modeling matrices identifying vulnerabilities, impact, and mitigations.
expect: Safe error responses, enumeration defense, and STRIDE threat modeling verified successfully.
